desktop.startup_failed.body.explanation: Paragraph under the heading explaining that the till program stopped right after opening.

desktop.startup_failed.detail.explanation: Label before the technical reason (for example an exit status) shown in small text for support.

desktop.startup_failed.logs.explanation: Sentence introducing the data folder path, asking the user to send the two log files from it to support. File names desktop.log and till.log stay unchanged.

desktop.startup_failed.step_reinstall.explanation: Second step in the numbered list: reinstall from the latest installer; saved data is kept. Keep the product name unchanged.

desktop.startup_failed.step_retry.explanation: First step in the numbered list: close the window and open the app again.

desktop.startup_failed.title.explanation: Heading of the window the desktop app shows when the till program stopped right after it was opened.

recovery.app_older_than_data.explanation: Recovery screen explanation when the till's database was written by a newer app version than the one now running (for example after installing an older or test build). Tells the owner to install the latest version. Must never suggest deleting or resetting data.

status.backup_copy.hint.explanation: Tooltip of the no-backup-copied chip: why and how to copy a backup off the till.

status.backup_copy.label.explanation: Status-bar chip for managers: no backup was downloaded or saved off this till in the last 7 days. Links to Settings → Backups.

status.cloud_auth.blocked.explanation: Status-bar chip on a till whose cloud registration the cloud refused for now because this till was in use recently: it can reconnect later and keeps selling.

status.cloud_auth.blocked_hint.explanation:
Tooltip of the 'Cloud reconnect paused' chip for a manager: when the till can reconnect, that selling is unaffected, and that support can allow it sooner.

Placeholders:
- %s: date and time the till can reconnect

status.cloud_auth.blocked_hint_short.explanation: Tooltip of the 'Cloud reconnect paused' chip for a cashier: neutral, no details; a manager finds them in Settings.

status.cloud_auth.in_use_elsewhere_hint.explanation: Tooltip of the status-bar chip for a manager when the till's identity is live on another machine (a copied data folder) and automatic retries stopped.

status.cloud_auth.key_refused_hint.explanation: Tooltip of the status-bar chip for a manager after the cloud refused this till's key proof.

status.cloud_auth.locked_out.explanation: Status-bar chip text for a registered till of an ownerless shop whose cloud sign-in was refused three times; short, one line.

status.cloud_auth.locked_out_hint.explanation: Tooltip of the status-bar chip for a manager when the cloud refuses this till's sign-in on an ownerless shop.

status.cloud_auth.register_new.explanation: Only used by till line 0.34; kept while that line is supported (ADR-0160 §5).

status.cloud_auth.replaced.explanation:
Status-bar chip on a till the shop's owner replaced as main till on my.universaltill.com. Names the till that replaced it.

Placeholders:
- %s: the name of the new main till, or 'the new main till' when unknown

status.cloud_auth.replaced_hint.explanation:
Tooltip of the 'Replaced by' chip: when the till was replaced and that its sales go nowhere.

Placeholders:
- %[1]s: the date it was replaced (YYYY-MM-DD)
- %[2]s: the name of the new main till, or 'the new main till' when unknown

status.cloud_auth.restored.explanation: Status-bar chip on a till whose data was restored from a phone or iCloud backup onto a new device: its cloud connection was reset and it must be connected again.

status.cloud_auth.restored_hint.explanation: Tooltip of the 'Restored on a new device' chip: the cloud connection was reset, the old device keeps its own, and the manager can pair again or register as a new store in Settings; selling continues.

status.cloud_heal.ask_manager.explanation: Added to the status-bar chip's tooltip for a signed-in person who may not open Settings.

status.cloud_heal.btn_code.explanation: Link in the status-bar chip that opens this till's page to connect with a pairing code.

status.cloud_heal.btn_enter_code.explanation: Link in the status-bar chip that opens this till's page to enter a pairing code.

status.cloud_heal.btn_join.explanation: Link in the status-bar chip that opens the page to join this till to the shop as an additional till.

status.cloud_heal.btn_new_shop.explanation: Link in the status-bar chip that opens Settings to register this till as a new shop.

status.cloud_heal.btn_open.explanation: Link in the status-bar chip that opens Settings, Till registration.

status.cloud_heal.cannot_prove.explanation: Full sentence (chip tooltip, Tills banner, Settings notice)  on a till that cannot prove its identity to its shop's cloud account; the owner makes a pairing code.

status.cloud_heal.cannot_prove_no_accoun.explanation: Status-bar chip on a till that cannot prove its identity and whose shop has no owner account to make a code.
Short words in the status-bar chip when a till cannot reconnect by itself and its shop has no online account.

status.cloud_heal.cannot_prove_short.explanation: Short words in the status-bar chip when a till cannot reconnect by itself and the shop owner can make a code.

status.cloud_heal.in_use_elsewhere.explanation: Status-bar chip when the same till data seems to run on two devices, so reconnecting by itself is paused.

status.cloud_heal.in_use_elsewhere_short.explanation: Short words in the status-bar chip when the same till data is in use on two devices.

status.cloud_heal.moved.explanation:
Status-bar chip on a till that was moved to another shop's account.

Placeholders:
- %s: the name of the other shop

status.cloud_heal.moved_full.explanation:
Full sentence (chip tooltip, Tills banner, Settings notice)  on a till that was moved to another shop's account.

Placeholders:
- %[1]s: the name of the other shop

status.cloud_heal.moved_short.explanation:
Short words in the status-bar chip on a till that now belongs to another shop.

Placeholders:
- %s: the name of the other shop

status.cloud_heal.reconnected.explanation: One-time notice after a till reconnected to its shop by itself.

status.cloud_heal.reconnecting.explanation: Full sentence (chip tooltip, Tills banner, Settings notice)  while a till reconnects by itself; no action needed and selling is unaffected.

status.cloud_heal.reconnecting_short.explanation: Short words in the status-bar chip while a till gets a new connection to its shop by itself; the full sentence is the chip's tooltip.

status.cloud_heal.removed.explanation: Full sentence (chip tooltip, Tills banner, Settings notice)  on a till the owner removed from the shop's cloud account on purpose; sales stay on the till.

status.cloud_heal.removed_short.explanation: Short words in the status-bar chip on a till that was removed from its shop's account.

status.cloud_heal.replaced.explanation:
Status-bar chip on a till the owner replaced as main till; it can still sell offline.

Placeholders:
- %s: the name of the new main till

status.cloud_heal.replaced_full.explanation:
Full sentence (chip tooltip, Tills banner, Settings notice)  on a till the owner replaced as main till; it can still sell offline.

Placeholders:
- %[1]s: the name of the new main till

status.cloud_heal.replaced_short.explanation:
Short words in the status-bar chip on a till that another till replaced as the main till.

Placeholders:
- %s: the name of the new main till

status.cloud_heal.replaced_unnamed.explanation: Sentence for a replaced till when the new main till's name is not known: chip tooltip, Tills page banner and Till registration notice.

status.cloud_heal.replaced_unnamed_short.explanation: Short words in the status-bar chip on a replaced till when the new main till's name is not known.

status.cloud_heal.role_conflict.explanation: Status-bar chip on a till that cannot reconnect with its old role because another till is the main till.

status.cloud_heal.role_conflict_short.explanation: Short words in the status-bar chip on a till that cannot reconnect as the main till because another till is the main till.

status.cloud_heal.shop_deleted.explanation: Status-bar chip on a till whose shop was deleted from its cloud account.

status.cloud_heal.shop_deleted_short.explanation: Short words in the status-bar chip on a till whose shop was deleted from its online account.

status.cloud_heal.unnamed_shop.explanation: Fallback name in the 'now belongs to' chip when the cloud did not give the other shop's name.

status.cloud_heal.waiting.explanation:
Full sentence (chip tooltip, Tills banner, Settings notice)  when a till must wait for a date (a new key is not yet trusted, or a daily limit was reached) before it reconnects by itself.

Placeholders:
- %s: the date and time it reconnects

status.cloud_heal.waiting_short.explanation:
Short words in the status-bar chip when a till will reconnect to its shop by itself at a later time.

Placeholders:
- %s: the date and time it reconnects

status.cloud_sync.at.explanation:
Status-bar chip: when this till last heard from the cloud, an hour or more ago. Short, one line.

Placeholders:
- %s: a clock time for today (14:05), or a date and time for an older sync, already formatted

status.cloud_sync.hint.explanation: Tooltip of the status-bar cloud sync chip. 'my.' is the cloud portal's product name; keep it as is.

status.cloud_sync.just_now.explanation: Status-bar chip: this till heard from the cloud less than a minute ago. Short, one line.

status.cloud_sync.minutes_ago_plural.explanation: Status-bar chip: minutes since this till last heard from the cloud, 1 to 59 ({count} is the number of minutes; plural forms per language). Short, one line; an abbreviation for minutes is fine.

status.cloud_sync.never.explanation: Status-bar chip: this registered till has not yet heard from the cloud. Short, one line.

status.cloud_sync.stale_hint.explanation: Tooltip of the status-bar cloud sync chip when the last sync is 10 minutes old or more.

status.cloud_sync.still_trying.explanation: Line in the status-bar cloud sync chip after Sync now when the cloud did not answer within a few seconds (offline or slow). The till keeps retrying; selling is not affected.

status.cloud_sync.sync_now.explanation: Button in the status-bar cloud sync chip (managers): ask the cloud for this till's latest changes now. A verb; short.

status.cloud_sync.syncing.explanation: Label of the Sync now button while the till waits (up to a few seconds) for the cloud's answer.

status.move_pending.explanation: Status-bar chip on every page, the sale screen included, shown to every role (cashiers too) while a request to move this till into another shop waits for a manager's approval. Read-only; names no shop. Short: it sits in the status bar.

status.move_pending_hint.explanation: Tooltip (title) of the pending-move status chip. Shown to cashiers too, so it names no shop and no deadline.

status.replaced.unnamed.explanation: Stands in for the new main till's name in the 'Replaced by' chip and banner while the cloud does not know it yet. Lower case: it sits inside a sentence.

status.replaced_banner.explanation:
Banner on every page of a till the shop's owner replaced as main till; it cannot be dismissed. Selling still works, but those sales reach neither the cloud nor the main till.

Placeholders:
- %[1]s: the name of the new main till, or 'the new main till' when unknown

status.shop_currency_mismatch.hint.explanation:
Status-bar chip title (tooltip), shown to a manager when this till's currency differs from the shop's currency on my. (the cloud portal; a product name, keep 'my.' as is) and the till did not switch by itself (it already has sales, or this till version does not know that currency). Explains both currencies and that the manager changes it in Settings.

Placeholders:
- %[1]s: the till's currency code, e.g. GBP
- %[2]s: the shop's currency code on my., e.g. EUR

status.shop_currency_mismatch.label.explanation: Status-bar chip label, shown to a manager when this till's currency differs from the shop's currency on my. Short: it sits in the status bar.

status.update_available_ask_manager.explanation: Status bar pill on an Android till for a signed-in person who cannot open Settings (a cashier): a newer version exists and a manager must install it. Shown after the words "Update available" and the version number ("Update available v1.2.3 — ask a manager"), never a button.

sync.error.name_too_long.explanation: Error body (400) the main till returns to a joining till, at pairing or enrolment, when the till name it sent is longer than 60 characters. The till is not enrolled and the one-time code is not used up.

sync.link.rejoin.explanation: Status-bar chip on a joined till whose connection to the main till was dropped (its data was restored onto a new device): tells the owner to join the main till again. Links to the Tills page.

sync.link.rejoin_hint.explanation: Tooltip of the 'join the main till again' status-bar chip: explains that the till no longer uses its old connection, that it keeps selling, and where to join again.

sync.quarantine_reason.single_purpose_vo.explanation: Reason column on /sync-quarantine: a journaled top-up of a single-purpose voucher (VAT fixed at issue) from an additional till was refused, so the entry is quarantined.

tills.add.another.get_code.explanation: Button that makes a new one-time pairing code and picture.

tills.add.another.help.explanation: Instruction above the Get a new code button.

tills.add.another.only_main.explanation:
Shown instead of the pairing code on a joined till.

Placeholders:
- %s: name of the main till

tills.add.another.replaced.explanation: Shown instead of the pairing code on a replaced main till.

tills.add.another.title.explanation: Heading of the section that shows the pairing code.

tills.add.chooser.another.explanation: Choice 1 on the Add a till tab.

tills.add.chooser.join.explanation: Choice 2 on the Add a till tab.

tills.add.chooser.replace.explanation: Choice 3 on the Add a till tab.

tills.add.chooser.title.explanation: Heading above the three choices on the Add a till tab.

tills.add.join.blocked.explanation: Shown instead of the join form on a main till that has other tills.

tills.add.replace.go.explanation: Button from the replace section to the Other tills tab.

tills.add.replace.help.explanation: Steps to replace a broken till.

tills.add.replace.main.explanation: Note for replacing a broken main till.

tills.add.replaced_join.explanation:
Button in the replaced notice that opens the join section; the placeholder names the new main till.

Placeholders:
- %s: name of the new main till

tills.add.replaced_join_unnamed.explanation: Button in the replaced notice when the new main till has no name yet.

tills.add.replaced_notice.explanation:
Notice on the Add a till tab of a replaced main till; the placeholder names the new main till.

Placeholders:
- %s: name of the new main till

tills.add.replaced_notice_unnamed.explanation: Notice on the Add a till tab of a replaced main till when the new main till has not reported its name.

tills.add.waiting_title.explanation: Heading of the card listing pair requests that wait for a manager.

tills.discovery.ambient.has_sales_confir.explanation: Label of a required tick box in the 'found a main till on this network' notice and above the join tabs on the Tills page, shown only when this till already has sales. Ticking it confirms that linking (or joining with a pairing code) replaces this till's sales, products and settings with the main till's copy.

tills.discovery.ambient.has_sales_warnin.explanation: Warning in the 'found a main till on this network' notice and above the join tabs on the Tills page, shown only when this till already has sales: linking (or joining with a pairing code) replaces everything on this till with the main till's copy, and this till's own sales are not sent to the main till (a copy stays in this till's backups folder). Also the error shown when a join is attempted without ticking the confirm box.

tills.discovery.result_name.explanation: Label before a main till's LAN identifier (a UUID). Shown in the 'Find a main till on this network' results (Tills page and setup wizard) and on the Tills page's main-till row, so an operator can check the till found in the scan is the right device. Both places must use the same word.

tills.join.needs_confirm.explanation: First line of the refusal when a join is blocked because this device already holds sales; the tick box below it is the next step.

tills.join.outcome.additional.explanation: One line under the join button saying what pressing it does.

tills.join.rejoin_note.explanation:
Note in a joined till's 'join an existing shop' section: joining another main till sends its unsent sales there first.

Placeholders:
- %d: how many unsent sales this till has

tills.join.rejoin_sales_warning.explanation: Warning above the join tabs on a till that is already joined to a main till and has sales: joining another main till replaces its data, but its unsent sales are sent there first.

tills.join_error.cloud_code.explanation: Error under the Additional till / Satellite join form when the 8-character my.universaltill.com shop code is typed there. Names the screens: Settings, Tills, Show pairing code; keep consistent.

tills.join_error.main_no_tls.explanation: Error shown under the join or pairing form on a satellite-to-be when the main till refuses a plain-HTTP join because it cannot serve a secure connection at all. Tells the person to restart the main till and try again.

tills.join_error.replaced.explanation: Join error on a till that tried to join a main till the shop's owner has replaced.

tills.join_error.satellite_tls_only.explanation: Error shown under the join or pairing form when a satellite could not join because this till could not make a secure connection to the main till. Tells the person to update this till if it runs an older version than the main till, otherwise to restart both tills, then try again.

tills.join_error.tls_only.explanation: Error shown under the join or pairing form when the main till only accepts secure connections and this till could not make one. Tells the person to update this till if it runs an older version than the main till, otherwise to restart both tills, then try again.

tills.join_error.unsent_day_closes.explanation:
Join error on a joined till: its day closes (Z reports) that the cloud must keep are not uploaded yet; joining would wipe them, so the join waits.

Placeholders:
- %s: how many day closes are not in the cloud yet

tills.join_error.unsent_day_closes_refus.explanation:
Join error on a joined till whose day closes cannot reach the cloud because the cloud refuses uploads (subscription not active).

Placeholders:
- %s: how many day closes are not in the cloud yet

iPhone/iPad app only, instead of tills.join_error.unsent_day_closes_refused: join error on a joined till whose day closes cannot reach the cloud because the cloud refuses uploads (subscription not active). Names the one fix the app can offer (report retention on this till); must not tell the reader to renew.

Placeholders:
- %s: how many day closes are not in the cloud yet

tills.join_error.unsent_not_sent.explanation:
Join error on a joined till re-joining a (new) main till: its sales that never reached a main till could not be sent there first, so the join was refused and nothing on this till changed.

Placeholders:
- %s: how many unsent sales this till has

tills.join_scan.clear.explanation: Button beside the scanned-code chip: empties the filled code so the person can scan again or type one.

tills.list.account_unavailable.explanation: Notice on Other tills when the shop's list of tills could not be read (offline). Nothing is marked old while it is unknown.

tills.list.ask_manager.explanation: Shown on a till that is not the main till, in place of the remove buttons.

tills.list.cloud_only.wait.explanation: Hint for an entry only in the shop list when the till cannot remove it from there: it needs nothing.

tills.list.col_status.explanation: Column heading of the other tills list.

tills.list.confirm_keep.explanation: Inline button that cancels removing a till.

tills.list.confirm_yes.explanation: Inline confirm button for removing a till.

tills.list.details_note.explanation: Note above the network detail table on the Other tills tab.

tills.list.error.account_unavailable.explanation: Refusal when removing stale tills while the account list cannot be read.

tills.list.error.cloud_remove_failed.explanation: Error when removing an entry from the shop's online list failed (offline, server error). Nothing was changed.

tills.list.error.cloud_remove_not_enable.explanation: Error on Other tills when removing an entry from the shop list was refused because the online list does not allow removals yet. Nothing was changed.

tills.list.error.not_listed.explanation: Error when a removal named an entry that is not in the freshly read shop list.

tills.list.error.pin_missing.explanation: Error under the manager PIN box on Other tills when a removal was tried with no PIN.

tills.list.error.pin_wrong.explanation: Error under the manager PIN box on Other tills when the PIN was wrong or locked out.

tills.list.error.remove_live.explanation:
Error when removing an entry that was seen working a moment ago. The placeholder is its name.

Placeholders:
- %s: till name

tills.list.fix_all.explanation:
Button in the banner on Other tills that removes every old entry shown. The placeholder is how many.

Placeholders:
- %d: number of old entries

tills.list.fix_all_confirm.explanation: Question asked before removing all old entries at once; the entry names follow it.

tills.list.fix_body_one.explanation: Banner text when exactly one old entry can be removed. Reassures: selling unaffected, nothing lost.

tills.list.fix_body_other.explanation:
Banner text when several old entries can be removed. The placeholder is how many.

Placeholders:
- %d: number of old entries

tills.list.fix_title.explanation: Banner title on Other tills when at least one entry can be removed right now (an old entry left over, for example from a phone that joined again).

tills.list.not_paired.explanation: Other tills tab: shown when this till was never paired with a shop account, so there is no account list to read.

tills.list.only_one.explanation: Empty state of the Other tills tab.

tills.list.pair_action.explanation: Button on the Other tills tab that opens Till registration to pair this till with a shop.

tills.list.pair_where.explanation: Hint under the pair button naming the settings path to Pair with a shop.

tills.list.pin_label.explanation: Label above the one manager PIN box on Other tills, shown when the signed-in person is not a manager.

tills.list.remove_cloud.explanation: Button on an entry that is only in the shop's online list: removes it from there.

tills.list.remove_cloud_aria.explanation:
Screen reader label of the Remove from the list button. The placeholder is the entry's name.

Placeholders:
- %s: till name

tills.list.remove_cloud_confirm.explanation:
Question before removing an entry from the shop's online list. The placeholder is its name.

Placeholders:
- %s: till name

tills.list.remove_confirm_old.explanation:
Question before removing one old entry. The placeholder is its name.

Placeholders:
- %s: till name

tills.list.remove_old.explanation: Button on an old entry row that removes it from this till's list.

tills.list.remove_old_aria.explanation:
Screen reader label of the Remove this old entry button. The placeholder is the entry's name.

Placeholders:
- %s: till name

tills.list.removed_ok.explanation:
Result line after one old entry was removed. The placeholder is its name.

Placeholders:
- %s: till name

tills.list.removed_ok_many.explanation:
Result line after several old entries were removed. The placeholder is how many.

Placeholders:
- %d: number of old entries

tills.list.role_mismatch.nothing.explanation: Second line under Roles differ: no action is needed, and where to change a role.

tills.list.same_name_hint.explanation:
Hint when two tills share a name but are different tills.

Placeholders:
- %s: till name

tills.list.show_it.explanation: Link in the disagreement banner to the first such row.

tills.list.state.cloud_only.explanation: Status tag: an entry is in the shop's online list but is not set up on this till.

tills.list.state.cloud_only.hint.explanation:
Hint under the Only in your shop list tag when removing it from the list is possible. The placeholder is its name.

Placeholders:
- %s: till name

tills.list.state.local_only.explanation: Status tag: a till joined recently and is not in the shop's online list yet.

tills.list.state.local_only.hint_old.explanation: Hint under the tag for a till not in the shop list and not seen for a while; a Remove button sits beside it.

tills.list.state.local_only.hint_recent.explanation: Hint under the tag for a till that joined recently. No button: nothing to do.

tills.list.state.local_only_old.explanation: Status tag: a till is not in the shop's online list and has not been seen for a while.

tills.list.state.ok.explanation: Status tag: the till is in both lists, or the account list is unavailable.

tills.list.state.old_entry.explanation: Status tag on the Other tills list for a till on this network that the account has removed or that has not been seen for 30 days; a Remove button sits next to it.

tills.list.state.old_entry.hint.explanation: Hint under the Old entry tag; the button Remove this old entry sits beside it.

tills.list.state.replaced.explanation: Status tag: this till was replaced.

tills.list.state.replaced.hint.explanation:
Hint under the replaced tag.

Placeholders:
- %s: name of the new main till

tills.list.state.role_mismatch.explanation: Status tag: the account and this network give the till different roles.

tills.list.state.role_mismatch.hint.explanation:
Hint under Roles differ. Placeholders: the role in the shop list, the role on this till.

Placeholders:
- %s: role in the shop list
- %s: role on this till

tills.list.state.same_device.explanation:
Status tag: this entry is the same device as another, newer entry (a device that joined again under a new name). The placeholder is the newer name.

Placeholders:
- %s: name of the newer entry

tills.list.state.same_device.hint.explanation:
Hint under the Replaced by tag. The placeholder is the newer entry's name.

Placeholders:
- %s: name of the newer entry

tills.list.try_again.explanation: Button that reads the account's list of tills again.

tills.main_unreachable_help.explanation: Only used by till line 0.34; kept while that line is supported (ADR-0160 §5).

tills.main_unreachable_help_offline.explanation: Notice on a joined till's Tills page while the main till is not answering: the till keeps selling, reconnects by itself, what to check.

tills.main_unreachable_replaced.explanation: Line in the 'main till isn't answering' notice on a joined till's Tills page: what to do when the main till was replaced, and that unsent sales go to the new main till first.

tills.pairing.error.this_till_replaced.explanation: Error on a replaced main till when a manager asks it for a pairing code for another till.

tills.pending.already_enrolled.explanation: Tag on a waiting pair request on the main till's Add a till tab: a till with this name is already in the list, so approving replaces the old entry.

tills.pending.already_enrolled_hint.explanation:
Hint under the Already enrolled here tag: approving replaces the old entry and no rename is needed. The placeholder is the 6-digit check code the joining till shows, which the manager compares.

Placeholders:
- %s: the verification code, digits

tills.pending.name_in_use.explanation: Tag on a waiting pair request when another till with this name is live on the network right now.

tills.pending.name_in_use_hint.explanation: Reason shown beside the disabled Approve button when the requested name belongs to a live till.

tills.pending.replace_gone.explanation: Error when the chosen old entry no longer exists.

tills.pending.replace_live.explanation: Error when the chosen old entry was seen working a moment ago.

tills.pending.replace_none.explanation: Default option of the replace select: do not replace anything.

tills.pending.replace_option.explanation:
Option of the replace select: an old entry's name and when it was last seen.

Placeholders:
- %s: old entry name
- %s: date last seen

tills.pending.replace_pick.explanation: Label of the select on a waiting request listing old entries the new device may replace.

tills.pending.replace_role.explanation: Error when the chosen old entry has another role than the joining device asked for.

tills.pending.same_phone.explanation:
Question on a waiting pair request when a till already in the list has the same device id: the manager can replace that old entry. The placeholder is its name.

Placeholders:
- %s: old entry name

tills.pending.same_phone_hint.explanation: Hint under the same-device question: nothing is lost on replace.

tills.pending.same_phone_no.explanation: Secondary button next to the same-device button: approve as a new device.

tills.pending.same_phone_yes.explanation:
Primary button on a waiting request that matches an old entry: approve and replace it. The placeholder is the old entry's name.

Placeholders:
- %s: old entry name
